notes: Polyglot repo. Primary test surface is Python (pytest). Python roots: system/ml-service (featurizer parity + app unit suites; needs pandas+numpy+pydantic, see requirements-test.txt) and system/shared/codegen/python (contract suite; needs the generated models via generate.sh). The backend (system/backend, TypeScript) has a Vitest suite for the correlation logic: `npm test` in system/backend. The TypeScript contract check is a separate compile-time tsc check at system/shared/codegen/typescript/test-contracts.ts, run via generate.sh + tsc.
